shared_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single reusable game inventory interface component, genuine transparent PNG. Primary request: create finished UI artwork for an elegant Roblox adventure inventory. Front-facing orthographic 2D interface plane, completely straight, no perspective or isometric tilt. Cohesive stylized 3D game-UI material: softly rounded corners, restrained tactile bevels, satin dark slate-blue surfaces (#1B2638, #263348), cool blue-gray rims (#435B79), gentle light from upper-left and quiet matte centers. Clean refined modern game UI, reads clearly at small sizes. Single isolated component only, fills its canvas tightly, transparency only beyond rounded outer edges, no outer margin or shadows beyond the shape, no background scene. Do not include any inventory items, weapon art, gemstones, text, numerals, labels, logos, watermarks, cursor or surrounding application. Never compose a whole filled interface. Keep interior empty and low contrast for editable text/content to be placed later. Avoid fantasy wood, ornate filigree, rivets, noisy textures, dramatic glows, multiple components or sprite sheets.
